sections.domain: Application documents, testing and license conditions
sections.heading: Application documents, testing and license conditions
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Application documents, testing and license conditions

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A19
A pay stub showing the applicant’s name and Social Security number can serve as Social Security number proof. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A19
A Nebraska document issued to an applicant with parolee immigration status is marked as unsuitable for federal identification. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A19
A parolee applicant still must meet the ordinary identification, verification and testing requirements. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A19
All noncommercial permit and operator-license applicants receive a vision test. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A19
The DMV’s vision screening checks both visual acuity and peripheral vision. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A19
When corrective lenses are necessary to meet the vision standard, the driver must wear them whenever driving. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A19
If the DMV vision standards are not met, an ophthalmologist or optometrist must check the findings. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A19
A person who cannot meet the minimum vision standard cannot receive a license. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A19
Each license class has a separate written test. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A19
The manual supplies written-test material for school learner, learner, school, provisional and Class O operator applicants. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A19
The drive test checks the applicant’s operation of the requested vehicle class in ordinary driving conditions. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A19
Licensing staff may require a drive test from any license applicant at their discretion. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A19
The applicant must provide a drive-test vehicle representative of the requested license class. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A19
The drive-test vehicle must be mechanically sound and have functioning brake lights. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A19
A drive-test vehicle from model year 1964 or later must have a clean working passenger belt for licensing staff. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A19
A drive-test vehicle from model year 1973 or later needs clean working belts for both staff and driver. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R17 | anchor: A19
The drive-test vehicle needs a working speedometer. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R18 | anchor: A20
The drive-test vehicle’s interior must be clean. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R19 | anchor: A20
The drive test may assess starting, stopping, turning, lane position, traffic controls, speed, right of way, parking and backing. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R20 | anchor: A20
After three consecutive Class O drive-test failures, reapplication requires proof of successful completion of a DMV-approved driver-training course or at least ninety days holding a learner permit. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R21 | anchor: A20
An applicant denied the requested document receives a Return for Services form explaining the denial. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R22 | anchor: A20
Bring the Return for Services form on the next licensing-office visit. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R23 | anchor: A20
A failed test cannot be repeated that same day. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R24 | anchor: A20
Present the issuance certificate within ninety days to a county treasurer outside Douglas, Lancaster and Sarpy Counties, or to a state driver-licensing office in one of those three counties. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R25 | anchor: A20
Missing the issuance-certificate deadline requires a return to the licensing office. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R26 | anchor: A20
The temporary receipt issued after payment is valid for 30 days. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R27 | anchor: A20
The temporary receipt is not accepted by the TSA as identification for boarding an aircraft or entering certain federal facilities. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R28 | anchor: A20
The permanent document is mailed to the address supplied to licensing staff and is not forwarded by the postal service. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R29 | anchor: A20
Applicants needing disability accommodations should contact the local licensing office or state DMV before testing. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R30 | anchor: A20
An applicant may appeal a licensing or identification-card refusal to the DMV Director. [A20]
Source: [A20 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R31 | anchor: A23
A safety concern reported by police, a physician or another person can lead the DMV to recall a driver for reexamination. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R32 | anchor: A23
A driver recalled for reexamination receives a letter identifying the office, date and time for written and drive tests. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R33 | anchor: A23
A recalled driver must supply a licensed physician’s driving-related medical statement and a vision statement from an optometrist or ophthalmologist. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R34 | anchor: A23
Failure to attend reexamination, provide required statements or pass required tests results in license cancellation. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R35 | anchor: A25
A Nebraska license issued to a U.S. citizen younger than twenty-one expires on the holder’s twenty-first birthday. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R36 | anchor: A25
A Nebraska license issued to a U.S. citizen aged at least twenty-one expires on the holder’s birthday in the fifth year after issuance. [A25]
Source: [A25 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R37 | anchor: A24
A changed name or address must be reported through the required document change within 60 days. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R38 | anchor: A24
Issuing a replacement license invalidates the previous document for identification use. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R39 | anchor: A24
Restriction B means corrective lenses are required. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R40 | anchor: A24
Restriction C identifies mechanical aids on the vehicle. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R41 | anchor: A24
Restriction E limits the license to an automatic-transmission vehicle. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R42 | anchor: A24
Restriction F requires outside mirrors. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R43 | anchor: A24
Restriction G limits driving to daylight. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R44 | anchor: A24
Restriction Q prohibits interstate driving. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R45 | anchor: A24
Restriction U requires automatic turn signals. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R46 | anchor: A24
Restriction V limits driving to the stated geographical area. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R47 | anchor: A24
Restriction W excludes one-way roads. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R48 | anchor: A24
Restriction X specifies a maximum driving speed. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R49 | anchor: A24
Restriction Y limits travel to two-lane roads carrying traffic in both directions. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R50 | anchor: A24
Restriction Z represents a special DMV-specified condition. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R51 | anchor: A24
Outside a renewal period, removing a restriction imposed from a medical or vision statement requires the applicable new physician or vision statement. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R52 | anchor: A24
A veteran designation requires eligibility certification through the Nebraska Department of Veterans’ Affairs. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R53 | anchor: A21
Voter registration is offered when applying for a Nebraska license or State ID Card. [A21]
Source: [A21 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R54 | anchor: A22
A permit, license or State ID holder aged sixteen or older may make an organ-and-tissue donation declaration through the DMV. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R55 | anchor: A22
A heart donor symbol appears on the document only when the holder chooses organ or tissue donation. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R56 | anchor: A22
For a donor between sixteen and eighteen, available parents or legal adult guardians may amend the minor’s donation decision. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R57 | anchor: A22
Donor status remains in place when the driving or identification document expires. [A22]
Source: [A22 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R58 | anchor: A23
A donation declared through a permit, license, State ID, donor card or donor registry cannot be rescinded after the donor’s death. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R59 | anchor: A23
A deceased donor’s family is included in the donation process but does not need to authorize the donation. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R60 | anchor: A23
A replacement document is available when the prior card has been lost or destroyed. [A23]
Source: [A23 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R61 | anchor: A24
A changed name or a move is a reason to obtain a replacement document. [A24]
Source: [A24 -> pdf-0024]
